title: Release something not ready or with less content early or work hard more time
author: Delicious_Bid8579
selftext:
I've been working on my 2D isometric mobile game last 2 months. Used claude to create the plot and gpt for arts. During the process I've found out that AI is not good with geometry not respecting at all,  and for a isometric game, geometry rules. Tried to use LORA and some paid services, but when geometry fit, art doesn't. So I realized lots of arts would require manual work, especially related with scale (when some objects are 2x2 and some 5x5, which should be represented way smaller). As the game is planned to have evolution in stages, the most complex arts (the ones that would require manual art) would be later in the  timeline.

Based on that, I'm on a dilemma. Should I release early with less content, and get public feedback ASAP, or work a year on that before release something?

Any insights would be helpful
